steps.label: VAR_BLUSHES starts at nought

steps.comment: Ott's first rung answers 'how is the work going' one of two ways, and which one is a conditional branch on Merribell being in the room. Four real faults reported accurately is only a moment if somebody present treats it as an ordinary sentence; without her Ott answers in one word and there is nothing to count. Both halves are asserted here, because a conditional blush that has only ever been run one way is indistinguishable from a blush somebody deleted.

steps.label: Merribell is not in the party yet
Ott, on her own: the answer is one word and it is not a moment
the same question with Merribell in the room: the drain cock
second rung: the line on the floor is not decorative
third: it is not a question with an answer, it is a question with a schedule
fourth: mind the swarf
and the last rung sets D by hand, which is what every appended page hangs on
fifth and every one after: she has settled, and does not bump it again
Nib is texture, not a Register A moment
nor is Tappet, who is on the cart
Spare has applied to join the party
and applying is not one of the moments
Spare, second: Sunday mornings
Spare, third: what his da calls his mam
and from then on he only asks whether he can come yet
Mrs Cotterill: the family is met
and Mr Cotterill is on nights
Mr Cotterill is the reaction shot and is deliberately not counted

steps.comment: The seven children added below are the answer to a house that had two moments in four beats, so the new material is clean and this asserts that it stayed clean. Bessie is the exception and is the only one of them that counts.

steps.label: Ferrule is in charge until six, and that is all she is
nor does Clevis's book on the name count
nor Shim
Bessie Marsden is the one of the seven that is a moment
and asking her again does not count it twice
nor is Old Sowerby, who is in the other register entirely
Mrs Tunnicliffe: the Cold Winter has been read out
and the arithmetic is one of the things nobody quite said
she will tell the Cold Winter again, and it is still one moment
Gudgeon, over the parish ledger, is another
and he is not counted twice either

steps.comment: The counter branch answers first and opens the shop second, so the choice has to be followed through one message window. It cannot be an `advance`: Shop Processing leaves $gameMap.isEventRunning() true for as long as the shop is up, so `advance` would go on pressing confirm inside Scene_Shop and start buying things.

steps.label: the second option is the counter, and it is a real shop
nine lines of stock

steps.comment: One Escape, not two - the second would land on the map and open the menu, which is how this check passed while the shop was not opening at all.

steps.label: and you can get out of it again
Hob is not in the party
so Bryd introduces himself and nothing else happens
Hob walks in and twenty years resumes exactly where it left off
once, and then they have not moved
and the town has not touched the cliche counter
